엄마.x: Mom made kimchi stew for me.
엄마.e: Casual word for 어머니 — sounds like 'mama' in many languages.

가을.x: The weather is cool in autumn.
가을.e: Harvest season — 추석, the Korean Thanksgiving, falls in 가을.

구두.x: I wore new dress shoes on the day of the interview.
구두.e: Probably from Japanese kutsu (shoes). Means formal leather shoes; sneakers are 운동화.

문제.t: 문제없어요! = 'No problem!' For a question you ask someone, use 질문 instead.

요리하다.e: 요리 (cooking, cuisine) + 하다 (do). 한국 요리 = Korean food.

태어나다.x: I was born in Seoul in 1998.
태어나다.e: Ends in 나다 (come out, appear); 태어난 날 = birthday.

취소.ex: 갑자기 비가 많이 와서 야구 경기가 취소됐어요.
취소.x: It suddenly rained hard, so the baseball game was canceled.
취소.t: Use 취소되다 when something gets canceled without saying who canceled it.

샌드위치.x: I made a quick sandwich for breakfast.
샌드위치.e: From English 'sandwich', with extra vowels added: 샌-드-위-치.

앞으로.m: from now on, in the future; forward
앞으로.x: From now on, I'll study Korean harder.
앞으로.t: The literal sense also exists: 앞으로 가세요 means 'go straight ahead'.

준비.ex: 시험 준비 때문에 요즘 너무 바빠요.
준비.x: I'm really busy these days because of exam prep.
준비.e: Literally 'bring up to standard and prepare'.

똑같다.m: to be exactly the same, to be identical
똑같다.x: My sister and I bought the exact same clothes.
똑같다.e: 똑 (exactly) + 같다 (to be the same) — a stronger 같다.

분식집.m: snack bar, cheap Korean snack restaurant
분식집.x: I ate tteokbokki at the snack bar in front of school.

냄새.x: The puppy is sniffing the ground.
냄새.t: 냄새 is neutral or unpleasant; for a pleasant scent, use 향기. Smell something actively with 맡다.

투자.ex: 요즘 주식 투자를 하는 젊은 사람이 많아요.
투자.x: These days a lot of young people invest in stocks.

연휴.x: I'm going down to my hometown over this long holiday.

시대.x: People in the Joseon era wore hanbok.

가뭄.x: The drought is severe this summer, so farmers are having a hard time.
가뭄.e: From 가물다 'to be dry (without rain)' + -ㅁ, a noun-making ending.

서운하다.m: hurt, let down, sad (especially by someone close)
서운하다.x: I felt hurt because my friend forgot my birthday.
서운하다.e: Close in meaning to 섭섭하다; both describe hurt feelings toward someone close.
서운하다.t: Also used at goodbyes: 떠나신다니 서운해요 'I'm sad you're leaving.'

질투.ex: 제가 새 옷을 사면 동생이 질투를 해요.
질투.x: When I buy new clothes, my younger sister gets jealous.
질투.e: Both syllables mean 'jealous', doubled for emphasis.
질투.t: 부럽다 is harmless 'envious'; 질투 has a negative, resentful edge.

흥미롭다.x: The content of that book was very interesting.
흥미롭다.e: -롭다 makes adjectives from nouns: 흥미롭다, 자유롭다, 평화롭다.

이미.ex: 제가 도착했을 때 영화는 이미 시작했어요.
이미.x: When I arrived, the movie had already started.
이미.t: 벌써 adds surprise that something happened early; 이미 just states it's already done.

굉장히.x: The performance I saw yesterday was incredibly fun.

관찰하다.x: The children observed the ants closely.

실시하다.m: to carry out, to conduct, to implement
실시하다.ex: 학교에서 다음 주에 건강 검사를 실시합니다.
실시하다.x: The school will conduct health checkups next week.
실시하다.t: Formal; common in news and notices, e.g. 조사를 실시하다 'to conduct a survey'.

해소하다.m: to relieve, to resolve, to get rid of (stress, a problem)
해소하다.t: 스트레스를 해소하다 means the same as 스트레스를 풀다, but 풀다 sounds more casual.

임금.x: The minimum wage went up a little this year.
임금.e: Literally 'hire money'; a native homonym 임금 means 'king'.

세련되다.ex: 새로 생긴 카페는 인테리어가 정말 세련됐어요.
세련되다.x: The new café has a really stylish interior.
세련되다.e: Literally 'washed and refined' — polished until elegant.

재판.ex: 그 사건의 재판은 다음 달에 열립니다.
재판.x: The trial for that case will be held next month.

기부하다.ex: 그 가수는 매년 어려운 이웃에게 돈을 기부해요.
기부하다.x: That singer donates money to neighbors in need every year.

나물.m: namul (seasoned vegetable side dish); edible greens
나물.ex: 엄마가 만든 나물 반찬이 제일 맛있어요.
나물.x: The namul side dishes my mom makes are the best.
나물.e: Native word for edible greens and wild herbs, and the dishes made from them.
나물.t: Usually blanched and seasoned with sesame oil and garlic. 콩나물 (bean sprouts) is the most common kind.

경영자.ex: 그 회사의 경영자는 직원들의 의견을 잘 들어요.
경영자.x: The head of that company listens carefully to employees' opinions.
경영자.e: Literally 'person who runs and manages'; -자 = person who does it: 과학자, 운전자.

문서.ex: 이 문서를 인쇄해서 회의 전에 나눠 주세요.
문서.x: Please print this document and hand it out before the meeting.
문서.t: 서류 means paper forms; 문서 also covers digital files.

부도.m: default, failure to pay (bills or checks); business failure
부도.ex: 경기가 나빠서 작은 회사들이 부도가 났어요.
부도.x: The economy was bad, so small companies defaulted.
부도.e: Literally 'not handed over': a bill or check that couldn't be paid.
부도.t: Used with 나다: 부도가 나다 = a company defaults; 부도 수표 = a bounced check.

검진.ex: 회사에서 일 년에 한 번 검진을 받아요.
검진.x: I get a checkup through my company once a year.

클라우드.ex: 사진을 클라우드에 저장하면 휴대폰을 잃어버려도 괜찮아요.
클라우드.x: If you save your photos to the cloud, it's okay even if you lose your phone.
클라우드.e: From English 'cloud'; only the computing sense, a real cloud is 구름.

개운하다.m: refreshed, clean-feeling; (of taste) clean and light
개운하다.ex: 샤워를 하고 나니까 몸이 정말 개운해요.
개운하다.x: After taking a shower, my body feels really refreshed.
개운하다.t: Also describes soups: 국물이 개운하다 means the broth tastes clean and not greasy.

세제.ex: 세탁기에 세제를 너무 많이 넣지 마세요.
세제.x: Don't put too much detergent in the washing machine.

성장률.x: This year's economic growth rate is expected to be 2 percent.
성장률.t: Pronounced [성장뉼]; the suffix is written -율 after a vowel or ㄴ, as in 비율.

지분.x: He owns a 30 percent stake in the company.

파기.m: scrapping, annulment, breaking (an agreement); destruction (of documents)
파기.x: One side unilaterally declared the contract void.

초래하다.m: to bring about, to cause, to result in (usually something bad)
초래하다.ex: 작은 실수가 큰 사고를 초래할 수 있습니다.
초래하다.x: A small mistake can lead to a big accident.
초래하다.e: Literally 'inviting it to come' — you invite trouble.
초래하다.t: Almost always negative: 피해, 혼란, 위기 (damage, confusion, crisis)를 초래하다.

간주하다.m: to regard as, to consider, to deem
간주하다.ex: 기한 내에 신청하지 않으면 포기한 것으로 간주합니다.
간주하다.x: If you don't apply by the deadline, it will be regarded as giving up.
간주하다.e: Literally 'seeing it as' — treating something as a certain status.

타결되다.m: to be settled, to reach an agreement
타결되다.ex: 오랜 협상 끝에 임금 협상이 타결되었습니다.
타결되다.x: After long negotiations, the wage talks reached a settlement.
타결되다.e: Literally 'agree and tie up' — negotiations knotted into a deal.

간과하다.m: to overlook, to miss, to fail to notice
간과하다.x: Even small mistakes should not be overlooked.

미련하다.x: Working through the pain like that is really foolish.
미련하다.e: Homonym warning: the noun 미련 also means 'lingering attachment' (미련이 남다).
미련하다.t: Often affectionate scolding for someone who stubbornly endures hardship: 미련하게 참지 마 'don't just tough it out'.

결자해지.m: whoever causes a problem should solve it; the one who tied the knot must untie it
결자해지.ex: 결자해지의 자세로 이번 문제를 직접 해결하겠습니다.
결자해지.x: Since I caused this problem, I'll take responsibility and solve it myself.
결자해지.e: Literally 'the one who tied it unties it.'
결자해지.t: Common in politics and news: 결자해지 차원에서 'as a matter of cleaning up one's own mess.'

의학적.ex: 이 방법은 아직 의학적 근거가 부족해요.
의학적.x: This method still lacks medical evidence.

첨언하다.m: to add a remark, to add a word
첨언하다.x: Finally, let me add just one more thing.
첨언하다.t: Very formal; you'll hear it in meetings and panel discussions, almost never in casual talk.

시가.x: This apartment's market price is over one billion won.
시가.e: Literally 'market price'; homonyms include 'cigar' and 'a husband's family home.'

호혜.ex: 두 나라는 호혜 원칙에 따라 관세를 낮추기로 했습니다.
호혜.x: The two countries decided to lower tariffs on the principle of mutual benefit.
호혜.t: Pronounced [호헤]; mostly used in compounds like 호혜적 관계, 호혜 평등.

수신제가.m: cultivating oneself and managing one's family (first steps of good leadership)
수신제가.ex: 수신제가도 못 하면서 나라를 다스리겠다는 거예요?
수신제가.x: You can't even manage yourself and your family, and you want to run the country?
수신제가.e: From the saying 수신제가치국평천하: self, family, state, then the world.
수신제가.t: Often used to criticize leaders whose family or personal life is a mess.

호스피스.ex: 아버지는 마지막 몇 주를 호스피스 병동에서 보내셨어요.
호스피스.x: My father spent his last few weeks in a hospice ward.

자연주의.ex: 자연주의 작가들은 인간을 환경의 영향을 받는 존재로 보았습니다.
자연주의.x: Naturalist writers saw humans as beings shaped by their environment.

관아.ex: 백성들이 관아 앞에 모여 억울함을 호소했어요.
관아.x: The people gathered in front of the government office to protest their unfair treatment.
관아.e: Literally 'official office', the local magistrate's compound.

내우외환.m: troubles at home and abroad, internal and external crises
내우외환.ex: 그 회사는 지금 내우외환에 시달리고 있습니다.
내우외환.x: That company is now suffering from both internal and external troubles.
내우외환.t: Common news collocations: 내우외환에 시달리다 / 내우외환을 겪다.

귀결되다.m: to come to (a conclusion), to end up in, to result in
귀결되다.ex: 결국 모든 논의는 비용 문제로 귀결됐습니다.
귀결되다.x: In the end, every discussion came down to the issue of cost.
귀결되다.e: Literally 'return and tie up' — everything ends up at one point.
귀결되다.t: Usually used with -(으)로: N(으)로 귀결되다 = to boil down to N.

유념하다.m: to bear in mind, to keep in mind
유념하다.x: Please keep the following points in mind.

소진하다.ex: 그는 마라톤 후반에 체력을 모두 소진했어요.
소진하다.x: He used up all his stamina in the second half of the marathon.

우대하다.m: to give preferential treatment, to favor
우대하다.ex: 이 회사는 신입 사원을 뽑을 때 경력자를 우대합니다.
우대하다.x: When hiring new employees, this company gives preference to experienced applicants.
우대하다.t: Job ads often say 경력자 우대 'experience preferred'.

어언.m: before one knows it, already (time passing)
어언.ex: 한국에 온 지 어언 십 년이 되었어요.
어언.x: Before I knew it, it's been ten years since I came to Korea.
어언.e: Built from two classical function syllables; used for time slipping by unnoticed.
어언.t: Almost always with a span of time: 어언 30년 'a good thirty years already'.

수탈하다.m: to exploit, to plunder, to extort
수탈하다.x: Imperial Japan plundered rice from its colony.

소산.ex: 이 작품은 작가의 오랜 노력의 소산입니다.
소산.x: This work is the fruit of the author's long effort.

가렴주구.m: harsh taxation and extortion of the people
가렴주구.ex: 조선 후기 백성들은 관리들의 가렴주구에 시달렸습니다.
가렴주구.x: In the late Joseon period, the people suffered from officials' harsh extortion.
가렴주구.e: Literally 'collect harshly, demand by force': greedy officials squeezing the people.
